# AiChat

AI chat on a Frame: a floating action button at the bottom right of the Page opens chat as a popup; from there it moves to the Frame's Panel or to full screen. It takes the Frame's props and adds the chat. - The button is the one way in. It hides while chat is open in the Panel or full screen. - The mode is remembered for the tab in sessionStorage (and an open Panel). - Under 768 the popup is shown full screen. - `variant="storybook"` is the Storybook docs' chat: the same chat, with its mode remembered under its own key. - The conversation moves with the mode and is kept for the tab (the last 50 messages, under `${storageKey}-messages`), so a reload keeps it. There is no backend: `respond(text, history)` returns the reply, `history` being the turns before it as `{ role, text }`. A reply is text, or `{ text, sources }`: the pages or records it drew on list under it.

Also asked as: chat, assistant, chatbot, conversation.

**Import:** `import { AiChat } from '@/patterns';`

## Usage

AI chat is the one way to ask AI about the page in front of you. Pick the mode for the size of the ask.

| Mode | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Popup | The default. A quick ask that keeps the page in view. |
| Panel | Ongoing work beside the page. The Frame docks it, or opens it over the Page on a Blanket when there is no room. |
| Full screen | Long answers that need room. It covers the window. |

AI chat applies the six AI rules from the AI overview.

1. **One AI identity, unnamed.** The chat is called AI chat and carries the AI icon. It has no persona name or avatar.
2. **Every answer is marked.** Each reply is an AI message, which leads with the AI icon.
3. **Fallibility, once.** "AI can make mistakes. Check important info." sits under the prompt input, never on each message.
4. **Sources when it draws on data.** A reply that used records lists them under the message: `respond` returns `{ text, sources }` instead of text.
5. **People confirm actions.** The chat proposes changes; anything that changes data waits for the person's confirm.
6. **Feedback on every answer.** Each reply offers thumbs up and thumbs down, and `onFeedback` receives the reply with its rating. The rating stays on the reply as chat moves between modes.

### Storybook variant

`variant="storybook"` is the chat in the Storybook docs. The docs' floating button opens it through its AI chat action, so the chat's own button is left out with `launcher={false}`: the popup floats above the bottom right corner instead. `respond` may return `{ text, sources }`, and the sources list under the answer, opening in `linkTarget`. The docs' answerer calls a server-side function that answers from the design-system index and holds the credentials, so none reaches the browser; when it errors or is rate limited, the chat searches the site's pages and the component index instead and says so.

## Best practices

### Use the popup for quick asks. {#use-the-popup-for-quick-asks}

A popup keeps the page in view. For ongoing work it covers the page and loses context: move it to the Panel.

### Use the Panel beside the page. {#use-the-panel-beside-the-page}

The Panel docks next to the work. For a quick ask it takes more room than the question needs.

### Use full screen for long work. {#use-full-screen-for-long-work}

Full screen gives long answers room. A docked Panel squeezes them.

### Mark every answer. {#mark-every-answer}

Do: Each reply is an AI message, led by the AI icon.
Don't: A reply in plain text reads as a person's.

### Say fallibility once. {#say-fallibility-once}

Do: One line, under the prompt input.
Don't: The line repeated under every reply turns into noise.

### List the sources an answer drew on. {#list-the-sources-an-answer-drew-on}

Do: The records the answer read, listed under it.
Don't: An answer from records with nothing to check it against.

## Accessibility

- The button is named by `title`, AI chat by default, and so is the Panel's complementary landmark unless `panelLabel` names it.
- The conversation is a log that announces new messages politely.
- Every reply carries one AI icon named "AI", so no answer reads as a person's to a screen reader.
- The thumbs are a group named "Rate this answer". A rated thumb is pressed, and a status line confirms the rating.
- The popup without the button (`launcher={false}`) takes focus in its prompt input on open, and Escape closes it.
- Full screen is a dialog named by `title`, and focus moves into it.

## Parts

1. **Button.** A primary circle Icon button with the AI icon, at the bottom right of the Page. It is the one way in, and it hides while chat is open in the Panel or full screen.
2. **Header.** The AI icon, the title and the controls: clear chat, switch mode (popup and Panel trade places), full screen, more and close. The Storybook variant carries clear chat, move to Panel and close.
3. **Conversation.** The person's messages on the sunken fill, and each reply as an AI message with its sources and thumbs.
4. **Prompt starters** (optional). Offered while the conversation is empty, from `starters`.
5. **Prompt input.** Where the person writes. While a reply is coming, its send button becomes Stop.
6. **Fallibility line.** One line under the prompt input.

The same surface fills every mode; the mode only changes which header controls show and where the surface sits.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Closed | Only the button shows. |
| Popup | The popup opens anchored to the button, over the Page. The button stays. |
| Panel | Chat docks in the Frame's Panel, or opens over the Page on a Blanket. The button hides. |
| Full screen | Chat covers the window, in a column capped at the reading width. The button hides. |
| Replying | A typing indicator stands in for the reply, and the prompt input's send button becomes Stop. |

Hover, pressed, focus and disabled belong to the Icon buttons in the header and the button, and are described on the Icon button page. Clear chat is disabled while the conversation is empty.

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Button | `--height-300` square, `--page-pad` from the Page's bottom and right edges, `--ds-shadow-overlay`. |
| Popup | Twice `--height-2000` wide and high; without the button it floats `--stack-md` above where the button would be. |
| Floating popup fill | `--ds-surface-overlay`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--popover-radius`. |
| Full screen | `--ds-surface`, on `--layer-dialog`; the conversation is capped at `--content-max-width-reading`. |
| Conversation | `--stack-md` between messages, `--body-default` in `--ds-text`. |
| The person's message | `--ds-surface-sunken`, `--pad-y-sm` by `--pad-x-md`, `--radius-md`. |
| Empty state and fallibility line | `--ds-text-subtle`; the line at `--body-small`. |
| Footer | `--stack-sm` between the starters, the input and the line. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Call it AI chat, with the AI icon. | A persona name or an avatar. |
| Short starters that say what they ask: "Summarize this page". | Starters that are whole paragraphs. |
| Say "AI can make mistakes. Check important info." once, under the prompt input. | A warning on each message. |
| Name a source by its record: "Session notes, Oct 24". | Bare links or ids. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `variant` | enum | `'app'` | `storybook` is the docs' chat, which remembers its mode under its own key; the controls are the same. |
| `defaultMode` | oneOf | `'popup'` | The mode a tab with nothing remembered starts in. |
| `defaultOpen` | bool | `false` | Whether chat starts open when the tab has nothing remembered. |
| `storageKey` | string | `variant === 'storybook' ? `${AI_CHAT_STORAGE_KEY}-storybook` : AI_CHAT_STORAGE_KEY` | The sessionStorage key the mode and the conversation are kept under (the Storybook variant has its own); null keeps nothing. |
| `launcher` | bool | `true` | `false` leaves out the floating button: the popup then floats above the bottom right corner, and the host opens chat with `useAiChat().dispatch({ type: 'open' })`. |
| `linkTarget` | string | — | Where a reply's links and source links open, such as `_top` from inside a frame. |
| `resolveHref` | func | — | Rewrites a link's address in a reply's text: `(href) => href`, such as a page named by its title. |
| `onModeChange` | func | — | Called with the new mode whenever chat moves between popup, Panel and full screen. |
| `respond` | func | — | Returns the reply (or a promise of it) to a sent message: a string, or `{ text, sources: [{ title, href, type }] }`. Without it nothing answers. |
| `onFeedback` | func | — | Called with the answer and `{ rating }` (or `{ rating: 'down', comment }`) when a person rates it. Every answer offers thumbs. |
| `starters` | arrayOf (required) | — | `{ id, label, text }` prompts offered in the empty conversation, under its opening line. |
| `title` | string | `'AI chat'` | The chat's name: the header title, the button's label and the Panel landmark. |
| `placeholder` | string | `'Ask anything'` | The prompt input's placeholder: what this chat can be asked about. Keep it to one line. |
| `emptyText` | string | `'Ask about what you are working on.'` | The line an empty conversation opens with, above the starters. |
| `panelLabel` | string | — | Overrides the Panel landmark's name; defaults to `title`. |
| `children` | node | — | The Page content. |

## Variants

**`variant`** — `app` · `storybook`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
